title: Add deterministic capability ranking
prompt: Implement rank_capabilities in capability_rank.py. Tokenize ASCII letters/digits case-insensitively, normalize the reviewed aliases js->javascript, auth->authentication, k8s->kubernetes, and ignore the stop words already declared. Validate all inputs. Deduplicate capabilities by case-insensitive name, retaining the most trusted source (system, then user, then plugin-cache, then project). Rank by descending number of distinct query tokens matched in name plus description, then source trust, then case-insensitive name. Return at most limit new dictionaries with exactly name, source, score, and sorted matched_terms; score is the match count. Exclude zero-match candidates and do not mutate inputs. Change only capability_rank.py. Do not seek or edit benchmark tests. Run any checks available inside this task repository and keep the final response under 120 words.

provenance.adaptation: A reduced feature fixture based on the repository's bounded capability ranking concepts. Its contract is benchmark-specific and does not reproduce the full production ranker.
